name: Old Faithful Lighting
description: Fixes beta's lighting errors: no light update is ever dropped, chunks are checked against their neighbours as they load, and light settles where b1.7.3's own rule says it should, so dark and bright patches under overhangs, at chunk borders and after explosions heal. Saves stay in b1.7.3's format.
authors: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic's AI), at Studio Quire
